course_detail_error_missing_text: Maybe its address has changed. See all the courses, or start with a free evaluation and we'll find the right course for your dog together.
course_detail_error_broken_text: Something went wrong and the course details didn't arrive. Reload the page or come back in a few minutes.
course_detail_hero_arrange: You arrange the type of class and the session times together.
course_detail_facts_sessions_note: It depends on your dog and the course.
course_detail_buy_body_evaluation: {trainer} meets your dog first. The evaluation is free.
course_detail_buy_body_visitor: Sign in to see which of your dogs can take this course.
course_detail_buy_body_no_dogs: First add your dog, then we'll see which courses are open to it.
course_detail_buy_action_visitor: Sign in and add to cart
course_detail_buy_action_pick: First pick one of your dogs
course_detail_buy_quieter_ask: Hasn't your dog been evaluated yet?
course_detail_buy_message_full: Your cart is full. Remove one of its items first.
course_detail_buy_after_pay: After you pay, {trainer} calls you and we plan it together.
course_detail_learn_title: By the end of the course I know these
course_detail_learn_place_home: This is the list for this course, just as {trainer} teaches it. All my practice happens at home, right where I live every day.
course_detail_learn_place_outside: This is the list for this course, just as {trainer} teaches it. My practice is outside, in the park or on the streets of our neighborhood, where I really do get distracted.
course_detail_learn_place_mostly_outside: This is the list for this course, just as {trainer} teaches it. Most of my practice is outside, in the park or on the streets of our neighborhood, where I really do get distracted.
course_detail_learn_branches_line: Each branch has its own program. After meeting me at the free evaluation, {trainer} tells you the right age, the number of sessions and the training place.
course_detail_learn_branches_note: The requirements and program of each branch are set after your dog's evaluation.
course_detail_learn_boarding_title: If you like, I can stay with the trainer
course_detail_learn_boarding_text: I stay at a boarding kennel and my training carries on there. It's optional, and priced separately from the course.
course_detail_lane_text: My courses open one after another, each after the one before.
course_detail_lane_age_body: For dogs {age} only. If I'm older, we'll find my right course at the free evaluation.
course_detail_lane_other_body: You can also start from {course}; it reaches the same result in {count} courses. Pick one, or we'll choose together at the free evaluation.
course_detail_closing_step_pick_detail: You buy the course you chose from your cart.
course_detail_closing_step_call_detail: You arrange the type of class, the times and the place of the sessions together.
course_detail_closing_step_train_detail: Where each course is trained is written on that course's page.
course_detail_closing_bubble: I started out just like this, too!
course_detail_closing_title: Before the course, {trainer} meets your dog
course_detail_closing_text: Courses open after the evaluation. The evaluation is free and there's no commitment. {trainer} meets your dog in person and tells you where to start.
